title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode2 Let's Finish It Together

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Sakki!
Is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nope! Actually, I came early because there's something I want to show you♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! A headband with a big ribbon on top! It's super cute!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And it's...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I searched around for one that looks just like yours!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, we're gonna be matching! Hey, c'mon, hurry up and try it on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! But first...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We could hear your excitement from out in the hallway.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here! Perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! Look! This headband matches Rin's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right...! It looks just like it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's very cute. I'm sure it'll look good on you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, don't you think so?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And what's more, it's not just this headband...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have enough for everyone to wear!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You do?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, when you say “everyone”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course, that includes you and KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'll be wonderful to all be matching. But what brought this on all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The reason...is to complete this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's...your list of things you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You made it in the hospital and wrote down stuff you wanted to do once you got better, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! And when I counted how many things were left to do the other day, I realized I could accomplish them all pretty soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
But there were a hundred things on the list, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, some of them were things like “Study in the same classroom as everyone”, so I'd finished a bunch before I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there are still some I haven't finished, so I figured I should just get them all done!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see.
So, these headbands are part of that then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's right!
Though, the official list item is “Match outfits with someone”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Making a photo album is another one of the things I haven't finished yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A photo album?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A third-year who used to be in my soft tennis club was saying the other day that if you have a photo album, you can make your memories last and remember them anytime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that made me want to make an album like that too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, as I'm doing all the other things on my list and making memories, I'm gonna take lots of pictures. And at the end of it all, I'm gonna put them all into an album!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see... That sounds just like something you'd want to do, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, it's been a while since I last heard you talk about that notebook.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... My head's been totally focused on all our band stuff lately...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I kept thinking that I wanted to see it through someday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because this notebook really means a lot to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course... It was clearly important to you from the way you looked after it while you were in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa suggested that I make this list when I was feeling lonely in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He said, “You're definitely going to get better, Saki. So, how about writing down the things you want to do once you're healthy? That'll be sure to get you excited!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ So, at first I wondered if that would actually help, but when I started writing, I really did start to feel excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks to that, I got to the point where I could go for tests and stuff with a positive attitude, and tell myself I was definitely gonna get better!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So that's how it started...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This notebook truly does mean a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, Saki, about your list... Do you think we can help with it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. You said there's not much left on it, didn't you? In that case, we'll come along for the ride until you finish it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Let's accomplish the rest of the things on your list together, and take lots of pictures for your album too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, can we take a picture with these matching headbands? Here, Shiho, this one's for you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do I have to wear one too...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course you do!
If we don't all wear them together, we won't be matching anymore!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... I did say I'd be along for the ride, but this is...kind of embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, don't worry. I'm sure it'll look good on you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She's right!
Shiho, pleeease!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Just this once, got it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Shiho, I love you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wha—
Hey, I'm putting it on, so don't cling on to me...!
